#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Hand-written scenario tests with explicit expected output."""
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.set_int_max_str_digits(8192)
SUB = "/app/submission/main.py"; PY = sys.executable

def canon(v): return json.dumps(v, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True)

fails = []

def run(cfg, reqs, name, ckpt_at=None, restart=False):
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    p = subprocess.run([PY, "-I", SUB, "compile"], input=canon(cfg).encode(),
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        fails.append((name, "compile failed", p.stdout))
        return
    prog = json.loads(p.stdout)
    path = os.path.join(d, "program.json")
    open(path, "w").write(json.dumps(prog))
    def launch(restore=None):
        pr = subprocess.Popen([PY, "-I", SUB, "stream", path],
                              stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
        out = []
        def send(r):
            pr.stdin.write((canon(r) + "\n").encode())
            pr.stdin.flush()
            line = pr.stdout.readline()
            out.append(json.loads(line) if line else None)
            return out[-1]
        if restore is not None:
            send({"op": "restore", "checkpoint": restore})
        return pr, send, out
    pr, send, out = launch()
    snap = None
    for i, r in enumerate(reqs):
        if ckpt_at is not None and i == ckpt_at:
            resp = send({"op": "checkpoint"})
            snap = resp["checkpoint"]
            if restart:
                pr.stdin.close(); pr.stdout.read(); pr.wait()
                pr, send, out2 = launch(restore=snap)
                out.extend(out2)
        send(r)
    pr.stdin.close()
    tail = pr.stdout.read()
    rc = pr.wait()
    if rc != 0 or tail:
        fails.append((name, "exit", rc, tail[:200]))
    return out

def check(name, cfg, reqs, expected, **kw):
    got = run(cfg, reqs, name, **kw)
    if got != expected:
        fails.append((name, got, expected))
        print("FAIL", name)
        for i in range(max(len(got), len(expected))):
            g = got[i] if i < len(got) else None
            e = expected[i] if i < len(expected) else None
            if g != e:
                print("  idx", i, "\n   got", canon(g)[:400], "\n   exp", canon(e)[:400])
    else:
        print("ok", name)

def C(it=1000, pl=1000, W=1, rules=(), fb=None):
    return {"version": 1, "idle_timeout": it, "packet_limit": pl, "prefix_width": W,
            "rules": list(rules), "fallback": fb or {"class": 77}}

def R(rid, cls, pri, ranges):
    return {"id": rid, "class": cls, "priority": pri, "ranges": ranges}

# --- A: overlapping occurrences of the same rule, key decision then audit
cfg = C(rules=[R(1, 5, 0, [[-2048, 2048], [5, 5]])])
reqs = [{"op": "open", "flow": 3, "time": 0},
        {"op": "chunk", "packets": [{"flow": 3, "time": 1, "source": 0, "length": 5},
                                    {"flow": 3, "time": 2, "source": 0, "length": 5},
                                    {"flow": 3, "time": 3, "source": 0, "length": 5}]},
        {"op": "close", "flow": 3, "time": 4}]
exp = [{"events": []},
       {"events": [{"type": "match", "flow": 3, "rule": 1, "start": 0, "end": 2},
                   {"type": "decision", "flow": 3, "class": 5, "reason": "key", "at": 2, "time": 2, "rule": 1},
                   {"type": "match", "flow": 3, "rule": 1, "start": 1, "end": 3}]},
       {"events": [{"type": "closed", "flow": 3, "packets": 3, "matches": 2, "class": 5, "reason": "key", "rule": 1}]}]
check("A overlap", cfg, reqs, exp)
check("A overlap restart", cfg, reqs, exp, ckpt_at=1, restart=True)

# --- B: priority / length / id tie-breaks, ascending rule id emission
cfg = C(rules=[R(1, 11, 5, [[1, 1], [1, 1]]), R(2, 22, 5, [[1, 1], [1, 1], [1, 1]]),
               R(9, 99, 4, [[1, 1], [1, 1], [1, 1]])])
reqs = [{"op": "open", "flow": 0, "time": 0},
        {"op": "chunk", "packets": [{"flow": 0, "time": 1, "source": 1, "length": 1},
                                    {"flow": 0, "time": 1, "source": 1, "length": 1},
                                    {"flow": 0, "time": 1, "source": 1, "length": 1}]}]
exp = [{"events": []},
       {"events": [{"type": "match", "flow": 0, "rule": 1, "start": 0, "end": 2},
                   {"type": "decision", "flow": 0, "class": 11, "reason": "key", "at": 2, "time": 1, "rule": 1},
                   {"type": "match", "flow": 0, "rule": 1, "start": 1, "end": 3},
                   {"type": "match", "flow": 0, "rule": 2, "start": 0, "end": 3},
                   {"type": "match", "flow": 0, "rule": 9, "start": 0, "end": 3}]}]
check("B earliest wins", cfg, reqs, exp)

# same packet, priority tie -> longest, then smallest id
cfg = C(pl=99, rules=[R(4, 44, 5, [[1, 1], [1, 1], [1, 1]]), R(6, 66, 5, [[1, 1], [1, 1], [1, 1]])])

                   {"type": "decision", "flow": 1, "class": 44, "reason": "key", "at": 3, "time": 0, "rule": 4}]}]
check("B2 tie id", cfg, reqs, exp)

# priority beats length

reqs = [{"op": "open", "flow": 1, "time": 0},
        {"op": "chunk", "packets": [{"flow": 1, "time": 0, "source": 0, "length": 1},

exp = [{"events": []},

                   {"type": "decision", "flow": 1, "class": 44, "reason": "key", "at": 1, "time": 0, "rule": 4},
                   {"type": "match", "flow": 1, "rule": 4, "start": 1, "end": 2},
                   {"type": "match", "flow": 1, "rule": 6, "start": 0, "end": 2}]}]
check("B3 earliest completion", cfg, reqs, exp)

# --- C: direction / sign handling, match across chunks
cfg = C(pl=99, rules=[R(3, 30, 0, [[10, 10], [-10, -10], [10, 10]])])
reqs = [{"op": "open", "flow": 8, "time": 0},
        {"op": "chunk", "packets": [{"flow": 8, "time": 1, "source": 1, "length": 10}]},
        {"op": "chunk", "packets": [{"flow": 8, "time": 2, "source": 0, "length": 10}]},
        {"op": "chunk", "packets": [{"flow": 8, "time": 3, "source": 1, "length": 10}]},
        {"op": "close", "flow": 8, "time": 3}]
exp = [{"events": []}, {"events": []}, {"events": []},
       {"events": [{"type": "match", "flow": 8, "rule": 3, "start": 0, "end": 3},
                   {"type": "decision", "flow": 8, "class": 30, "reason": "key", "at": 3, "time": 3, "rule": 3}]},
       {"events": [{"type": "closed", "flow": 8, "packets": 3, "matches": 1, "class": 30, "reason": "key", "rule": 3}]}]
check("C signs across chunks", cfg, reqs, exp)
# reverse endpoint first => features negative
reqs2 = [{"op": "open", "flow": 8, "time": 0},
         {"op": "chunk", "packets": [{"flow": 8, "time": 1, "source": 0, "length": 10},
                                     {"flow": 8, "time": 2, "source": 1, "length": 10},
                                     {"flow": 8, "time": 3, "source": 0, "length": 10}]}]
exp2 = [{"events": []},
        {"events": [{"type": "match", "flow": 8, "rule": 3, "start": 0, "end": 3},
                    {"type": "decision", "flow": 8, "class": 30, "reason": "key", "at": 3, "time": 3, "rule": 3}]}]
check("C2 signs reversed", cfg, reqs2, exp2)

# --- D: idle expiry ordering + at/time semantics + still audited afterwards
cfg = C(it=2, pl=100, W=2,
        rules=[R(1, 5, 0, [[4, 4]])],
        fb={"feature": 0, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 1}, "gt": {"class": 2}})

        {"op": "open", "flow": 2, "time": 0},

        {"op": "tick", "time": 4},
        {"op": "chunk", "packets": [{"flow": 9, "time": 4, "source": 0, "length": 4},
                                    {"flow": 2, "time": 4, "source": 0, "length": 4}]},
        {"op": "close", "flow": 9, "time": 5},
        {"op": "close", "flow": 2, "time": 5}]
exp = [{"events": []},

                   {"type": "decision", "flow": 9, "class": 5, "reason": "key", "at": 1, "time": 1, "rule": 1}]},
       {"events": [{"type": "decision", "flow": 2, "class": 1, "reason": "idle", "at": 0, "time": 4, "rule": None}]},
       {"events": [{"type": "match", "flow": 9, "rule": 1, "start": 1, "end": 2}]},
       {"events": [{"type": "closed", "flow": 9, "packets": 2, "matches": 2, "class": 5, "reason": "key", "rule": 1}]},
